newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks rise amid earnings deluge.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks rise amid earnings deluge.

text.p: MADRID, Sept 2 (Reuter) (1700 GMT) - Madrid stocks ended Monday slightly higher, largely shrugging aside a bunch of corporate results. Trade was quiet, given the closure of Wall Street as the market awaited news of crucial 1997 budget.
* General index closes up 0.48 points, or 0.14 percent, to 354.45. IBEX-35 index ends up 8.09 points, or 0.2 percent, at 4033.56.
* Tabacalera up 40 at 5,140 after first half results rose 10.8 pct. Pryca up 40 at 3,070 after news its H1 net up 24 pct. Sevillana up 15 at 1,020 on 23 pct profit rise in first half.
